patterns.name: Bank / KYC Scam
patterns.description: A scammer impersonates a bank or financial service and claims that KYC, an account or a card needs urgent verification.
common_claims: Your KYC has expired.
Your bank account will be blocked.
Your debit card will be deactivated.
Your account needs immediate verification.
safe_response: Do not click the supplied link.
Do not share OTP, PIN, password or CVV.
Open the official banking application yourself.
Contact the bank through an official channel.

patterns.name: Digital Arrest Scam
patterns.description: A scammer impersonates police, investigators or government authorities and uses threats, video calls or legal claims to pressure the victim.
common_claims: Your Aadhaar is linked to illegal activity.
A parcel in your name contains illegal material.
There is a money-laundering case against you.
You are under digital arrest.
You must stay on video call with the officer.
safe_response: End the call.
Do not transfer money to a so-called safe account.
Do not install remote-access software.
Verify the claim independently.
Tell a trusted person.

patterns.name: Courier / Parcel Scam
patterns.description: A scammer claims that a parcel connected to the victim contains illegal or suspicious material and demands money or personal information.
common_claims: A parcel in your name has been seized.
Illegal items were found in your parcel.
Customs clearance is required immediately.
A police case has been registered for your parcel.
safe_response: Do not pay the caller.
Do not share banking information.
Do not install an application.
Verify the parcel through the courier's official website.

patterns.name: Job / Work-from-Home Scam
patterns.description: A scammer offers a job or work-from-home opportunity and later demands registration, training, security or processing fees.
common_claims: You have been selected for a job.
Earn money from home.
Pay a small registration fee.
Pay a refundable security deposit.
Complete this task to unlock your salary.
safe_response: Do not pay to obtain a job.
Verify the employer independently.
Do not share banking credentials.
Do not install unknown applications.

patterns.name: Investment / Trading Scam
patterns.description: A scammer promises guaranteed or unusually high investment returns and pressures the victim to deposit money.
common_claims: Guaranteed high returns.
Double your money quickly.
Risk-free investment.
Guaranteed trading profit.
Exclusive investment opportunity.
safe_response: Do not transfer money because of pressure.
Do not trust guaranteed returns.
Verify the company independently.
Do not install remote-access software.

patterns.name: Prize / Lottery Scam
patterns.description: A scammer claims that the victim has won a prize, lottery or reward and demands a payment before releasing it.
common_claims: Congratulations, you won a prize.
You have won the lottery.
Pay the processing fee to claim your reward.
Pay the tax to receive the prize.
safe_response: Do not pay a fee to claim an unexpected prize.
Do not share banking credentials.
Verify the promotion independently.

patterns.name: QR / UPI Payment Scam
patterns.description: A scammer sends a QR code or payment request and falsely claims that scanning or approving it will result in receiving money.
common_claims: Scan this QR code to receive payment.
Enter your UPI PIN to receive the refund.
Approve this collect request.
Scan the QR code to verify your account.
safe_response: Do not scan an unexpected QR code.
You do not need to enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
Check the recipient and amount before approving a payment.
Cancel unexpected payment requests.

patterns.name: Remote Access Scam
patterns.description: A scammer convinces the victim to install remote-control software or share their screen.
common_claims: Install this application so I can help you.
Give me remote access to fix your account.
Share your screen so I can verify your identity.
Install AnyDesk or another support application.
safe_response: Do not install remote-access software because of an unexpected caller.
Do not share your screen.
End the call if the person continues pressuring you.
Contact the organization through an official channel.

patterns.name: Recovery Scam
patterns.description: A scammer contacts someone who has already lost money and promises to recover it in exchange for another payment or sensitive information.
common_claims: We can recover your stolen money.
Pay a recovery fee.
We are from the cybercrime recovery department.
Your money is ready to be returned.
safe_response: Do not pay an unofficial recovery agent.
Do not share OTP, PIN or passwords.
Use official banking and cybercrime reporting channels.
Preserve evidence from the original incident.

patterns.name: SIM / Telecom KYC Scam
patterns.description: A scammer claims that a SIM card or mobile connection will be disconnected unless the victim completes an urgent verification.
common_claims: Your SIM will be blocked today.
Complete KYC immediately.
Your mobile number is involved in illegal activity.
Install this application for SIM verification.
safe_response: Do not install an application sent by the caller.
Do not share OTP or banking credentials.
Verify the claim through your telecom provider's official channels.

patterns.name: Sextortion / Blackmail Scam
patterns.description: A scammer threatens to publish or report private material unless the victim sends money or follows instructions.
common_claims: We will publish your video.
Pay immediately or we will contact your family.
A police case will be filed unless you pay.
Send money to delete the recording.
safe_response: Do not pay because of threats.
Do not provide additional private material.
Preserve evidence.
Seek help from a trusted person.
Use official reporting channels when appropriate.
